Package sc.protocol.requests

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    AdminLobbyRequest
    Marks requests only allowed after successful authentication.
    ILobbyRequest
    Parent for all packets handled by the Lobby.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AuthenticateRequest
    Authenticates a client as administrator to send interface AdminLobbyRequests. Is not answered if successful.
    CancelRequest
    Deletes the GameRoom and cancels the Game within.
    JoinGameRequest
    Join a game by gameType. Creates a new gameRoom if no open gameRoom of the specified gameType exists.
    JoinPreparedRoomRequest
    Join a prepared game by reservation. The code is handed out by the administrative client that created the game via a PrepareGameRequest.
    JoinRoomRequest
    Join a prepared GameRoom without reservation.
    ObservationRequest
    Request by administrative client to observe a gameRoom specified by given roomId.
    PauseGameRequest
    Request by administrative client to pause or unpause a game specified by given roomId.
    PrepareGameRequest
    Prepare a game of gameType with slots according to slotDescriptors.
    StepRequest
    Request by administrative client to send a MoveRequest to the current player. Only works for paused games.
